description: datashed is a commercial data management platform for exploration, grade control and mining data. It centralises drillhole capture, logging and sample tracking, manages laboratory submissions and quality control of assays with automated validation, loads files automatically for assays, portable XRF, hyperspectral and survey data, and provides dashboards and Power BI reports, working with maxgeo's logchief field logging software and third-party tools. It is sold by maxgeo, which also offers logchief and LeaseCTRL for tenement management. Coverage is global. It is paid software with flexible role-based licences, web-based deployment and cloud access, and connections to more than 40 applications; demonstrations are arranged on request and no prices are published. Caveats: the product page is marketing material without technical detail on data models or export formats, and the data held are each company's own. For simulation it is the kind of system in which mines keep the geological and grade data that feed mine planning, production scheduling and resource models, so it matters when such models are set up from operating mine data. It is related to the OpenLog QGIS plugin record in this catalogue, an open-source tool for the same drillhole data.
